items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: as usual we play tunes associated with Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: You know it’s Flushing Town Hall in Queens. It’s a very nice, well run, prestigious, state-of-the-art organization that presents concerts all the time. And I run the jam session once a month. It’s a very well attended jam session. It’s called the Louis Armstrong Legacy Flushing Town Hall Jazz Jam Session. A monthly jazz jam. Because it’s funded by the Louis Armstrong Educational Foundation. And well it’s so popular. You know I’ve been doing it for maybe four or five years and it’s growing and growing, and the…

the house band, as usual we play tunes associated with Louis Armstrong. So we still have all our house band members. And now the advantage is this: we get participants from all over the world, which you cannot do at a live jam. So last month we had New Zealand, Australia, Italy, and Germany. And the month before that we had Colorado, Italy, and a few other places, I can’t remember.
Are people able to chime in with comments?
